pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown irregular polygons with sharp, jagged edge gradients. The edges exhibit high-frequency angularity and a high area-to-perimeter ratio.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored interstitial network with distinct tri-radiate and tetra-radiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank but narrows significantly towards the lower limbs.
